rules.R1: Ask the postcode first, then the last four digits of the account number.
rules.R2: Two wrong identity answers in total end the identity check.
rules.R3: Postcodes are sent to verify_identity in capitals with all spaces removed.
rules.R4: Business days are Mon-Fri except 2026-11-30, 2026-12-25, 2026-12-28, 2026-12-31, 2027-01-01; promises only on business days.
rules.R5: Deadline by band: days_late 1-10 = 8th business day after today; 11-30 = today+14 calendar days, moved forward to a business day; 31-60 = last calendar day of the month, moved back to a business day.
rules.R6: Floor is minimum_due (credit card, overdraft) or monthly_instalment (personal loan), capped at past_due.
rules.R7: Ladder: attempt 1 past_due on next business day (or deadline if earlier); middle attempt 2 floor on deadline; late attempt 2 past_due on deadline, attempt 3 floor on deadline; exact repeats are skipped. Early 1, middle 2, late 3 attempts.
rules.R8: Third-party callback: business day, today or next two business days, 09:30-18:00 inclusive, later than now.
rules.R9: create_promise amount is sent in pence as a whole number.
rules.R10: Closing table: outcome/reason, note reason (paid, refused, dispute, system failure only) and transfer queue per situation.

Send a postcode in capital letters with every space removed ("eh3 9qp" is sent as `EH39QP`).
Send the amount to `create_promise` in pence, as a whole number: £85.50 is sent as `8550`.
